get.description:
Get a collection of `Customer Accounting` objects.
The result set can be restricted through filter parameter.
Only `Customer Accounting` objects will be returned that can be accessed by the user (security applied).
Paging is supported with parameters *limit* and *offset*.

*Get a `Customer Accounting` object by ID*.
Only `Customer Accounting` object will be returned that can be accessed by the user (security applied).
If user does not have access to resource, not found error will be returned instead of unauthorized - to disallow attacks.

parameters.description: ID of the `Customer Accounting` object to get
